messages:
maria: heads-up — trying to onboard sirocco-14B (univ lab release) for eval + quant experiments. license bundle attached in repo. quick skim shows 'NonCommercial' + 'ShareAlike' + an extra line that says 'no redistribution of modified weights'. can we host this on Redwood hosted API or Dedicated? can we offer quantized model downloads for Private deployments? cc @sam-legal @ajay

sam-legal: quick take: NonCommercial is a hard block for any paid hosting. sharealike means derivatives must be offered under same terms. the explicit 'no redistribution of modified weights' is also concerning — that would likely prohibit us from shipping quantized weights. need to see the exact license text and origin (contact/author).

ajay: thanks. fwiw our Dedicated/Hosted APIs do not give out raw weights, but for Private/on-prem we sometimes transfer artifacts. question: does inference-as-a-service count as redistribution under this license?

sam-legal: generally, feeding requests to a hosted model (you running the model and returning outputs) is different from distribution of weights, but NonCommercial often prohibits charging for any service that uses the model. so hosting for paying customers likely violates NC. sharealike won't restrict hosting per se, but the 'no redistribution' clause would block us from shipping quantized weights to customers. need license file and provenance.

lisa: infra note: for Private we create a container with weights and push it to customer S3 or transfer via secure link — that's definitely redistribution. for Dedicated, model runs inside our fleet; customers don't get weights. so two separate compliance vectors.

maria: pasting the exact snippet from LICENSE.txt:
```
Non-Commercial Use Only. You may not use this model or any derivatives for commercial purposes (defined as providing access to the model or outputs for a fee, or using the model in products or services that generate revenue).

ShareAlike 4.0: Any derivatives must be released under the same license.

Prohibition: No distribution of modified or converted model weights or checkpoints, including but not limited to quantized, pruned, or otherwise altered weights.
```

noah: product POV — if we can't host commercially, that blocks a lot of customer scenarios. could ask upstream for a commercial license or a waiver for quantization/distribution. is there an upstream contact?

ajay: we can still run offline evals and quant experiments internally for research, but we should not deploy to Hosted/Dedicated paid tiers or ship quantized weights to customers until legal confirms. also check embeddings usage — some NC licenses restrict training/embedding export too.

sam-legal: next steps: (1) who is upstream contact? (2) confirm provenance (dataset/training deps) — sometimes third-party data triggers additional obligations; (3) until we get a commercial license or explicit permission to redistribute quantized artifacts, mark model as blocked for commercial onboarding. i can draft an outreach template.

deploy-bot: created checklist ml-onboarding/1728509876, assigned to @maria and @sam-legal :page_with_curl:

maria: thanks — upstream is prof. yuan at uni-lab; i'll DM her and attach the license file + a short request for a commercial license or redistribution waiver. pausing public onboarding and Dedicated rollout for now. will update thread with reply. :pray:
